fields.title: Managed Services vs Software vs Compliance Scheme
fields.fields[heroTitle]: Managed service, software, or compliance scheme: which do you actually need?
fields.fields[heroIntroduction]: Most packaging producers are sold one of three things and told it's the same thing. It isn't. A compliance scheme places your waste obligation. Software gives you a tool and leaves you to run it. A managed service does the work and stands behind the numbers. This page explains the difference honestly, including where each one beats the others.
fields.fields[pageBuilder][entries][uid:965ffc6: Ecoveritas operates no compliance scheme, holds no PRN book, and has no waste contract. We have no financial interest in which scheme you use.
fields.fields[pageBuilder][entries][uid:4cb0e06:
Why this distinction matters


The three models have different incentives. A compliance scheme earns more when you place more tonnage through it. Software earns the same whether your data is right or wrong. A managed service earns on the accuracy of the submission itself.
 

None of that makes any of them dishonest. It does mean you should know which one you're buying.

Where each one wins


If you want your obligation placed and discharged with minimal involvement, a scheme is the simplest route. If you have a large in-house compliance team and want tooling rather than people, software is cheaper. If your data is messy, sits across multiple systems, or you suspect you're overpaying, a managed service is the only one of the three that will go and find out.
fields.fields[pageBuilder][entries][uid:6a9b37a:
Which is Ecoveritas?

Well, we can be all three... Depending on your needs.


At heart we're a managed service. Our platform is how we deliver it, not what we sell. We take no margin on tonnage, hold no PRN book, and don't operate a scheme, so when we tell you a classification is wrong, there's no version of that where we benefit from the answer.
fields.fields[pageBuilder][entries][uid:52cbc95:
Not sure which model fits?

Tell us how your packaging data currently sits and we'll tell you honestly which of the three you need, including when it isn't us.
